```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
```

#Setup
```{r}
household <- read.csv("/Users/bryce/Downloads/Career/Stats Projects/CSV_data_files/faps_household_puf.csv")

childcare <- household |>
  dplyr::select(foodsufficient,expchildcare_r,famsize,adltfscat,foodsecureq2,schservebrkfst,incfamreported_r) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !foodsufficient %in% c(-998,-997,-996),
    !expchildcare_r %in% c(-998,-997,-997),
    !schservebrkfst %in% c(-998,-997,-996),
    !schservebrkfst %in% c(-997))
```

#School Breakfast Provided
```{r}
#Difference in School Breakfast Provided
childcare |>
  mutate(schservebrkfst = factor(schservebrkfst, 
                                  levels = c(1, 0), 
                                  labels = c("Yes", "No"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = schservebrkfst, fill = schservebrkfst)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "School Breakfast Availability Among Households",
    x = "School Serves Breakfast",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "steelblue", "No" = "tomato")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


#Spending Based on School Breakfast Provided
childcare |>
  mutate(
    spends_childcare = ifelse(expchildcare_r > 0, "Spends on childcare", "Does not spend"),
    schservebrkfst = factor(schservebrkfst, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Yes", "No"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = schservebrkfst, fill = spends_childcare)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Childcare Spending by School Breakfast Availability",
    x = "School Serves Breakfast",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Childcare Spending"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Does not spend" = "steelblue",
                                "Spends on childcare" = "tomato")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal()

# Chi-square test
chisq.test(table(childcare$schservebrkfst, childcare$expchildcare_r > 0))
```


#Food Security by School Breakfast Availability
```{r}
childcare |>
  mutate(schservebrkfst = factor(schservebrkfst, 
                                  levels = c(1, 0), 
                                  labels = c("Yes", "No"))) |>
 ggplot(aes(x = schservebrkfst, y = foodsecureq2, fill = schservebrkfst)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Food Security Score by School Breakfast Availability",
    x = "School Serves Breakfast",
    y = "Food Security Score"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "steelblue", "No" = "tomato")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
#Difference Testing
```{r}
# Split into two groups
yes_breakfast <- childcare |> filter(schservebrkfst == 1) |> pull(foodsecureq2)
no_breakfast  <- childcare |> filter(schservebrkfst == 0) |> pull(foodsecureq2)

# --- Shapiro-Wilk Normality Tests ---
shapiro.test(yes_breakfast)
shapiro.test(no_breakfast)

# --- QQ Plots ---
childcare |>
  mutate(schservebrkfst = factor(schservebrkfst,
                                  levels = c(1, 0),
                                  labels = c("Yes", "No"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(sample = foodsecureq2, color = schservebrkfst)) +
  geom_qq() +
  geom_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~schservebrkfst) +
  labs(
    title = "QQ Plot of Food Security Score by School Breakfast Availability",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "steelblue", "No" = "tomato")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --- Wilcoxon Test ---
wilcox.test(foodsecureq2 ~ schservebrkfst, data = childcare)

#--- Chi-Sq. Test ---
table(childcare$schservebrkfst, childcare$foodsecureq2)
chisq.test(table(childcare$schservebrkfst, childcare$foodsecureq2))

#Testing Direction of the Relationship -- Ordinal Outcome Linear Model
fit <- MASS::polr(factor(foodsecureq2, ordered = TRUE) ~ schservebrkfst,
           data = childcare, Hess = TRUE)

ctable <- coef(summary(fit))
p <- pnorm(abs(ctable[, "t value"]), lower.tail = FALSE) * 2
cbind(ctable, "p value" = p)

# Odds ratio with 95% CI
exp(cbind(OR = coef(fit), confint(fit)))
```

#Comparison Based on Childcare Spending
```{r}
# Split into two groups
spenders     <- childcare |> filter(expchildcare_r > 0)
non_spenders <- childcare |> filter(expchildcare_r == 0)

# --- Stratified Chi-Square Tests ---
cat("=== Families Who Spend on Childcare ===\n")
chisq.test(table(spenders$schservebrkfst, spenders$foodsecureq2))

cat("\n=== Families Who Do Not Spend on Childcare ===\n")
chisq.test(table(non_spenders$schservebrkfst, non_spenders$foodsecureq2))

childcare |>
  mutate(
    spends_childcare = ifelse(expchildcare_r > 0, "Spends on childcare", "Does not spend"),
    schservebrkfst = factor(schservebrkfst, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Yes", "No"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = schservebrkfst, fill = factor(foodsecureq2))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~spends_childcare) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Food Security by School Breakfast Availability",
    subtitle = "Stratified by Childcare Spending",
    x = "School Serves Breakfast",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Food Security Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
model_data <- childcare |>
  filter(!foodsecureq2    %in% c(-998, -997, -996),
         !schservebrkfst  %in% c(-998, -997, -996),
         !expchildcare_r  %in% c(-998, -997, -996),
         !incfamreported_r  %in% c(-998, -997, -996)) |>
  mutate(
    foodsec = factor(foodsecureq2, levels = c(1, 2, 3), ordered = TRUE),
    brkfst  = factor(schservebrkfst, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Yes", "No")),
    spends  = factor(expchildcare_r > 0, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    income_k = incfamreported_r / 1000          # odds ratio per $1,000
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(foodsec), !is.na(brkfst), !is.na(income_k))

# Model 0: intercept only
m0 <- polr(foodsec ~ 1, data = model_data, Hess = TRUE)

# Model 1: income only
m1 <- polr(foodsec ~ income_k, data = model_data, Hess = TRUE)

# Model 2: income + categorical predictors
m2 <- polr(foodsec ~ income_k + brkfst, data = model_data, Hess = TRUE)

# Likelihood ratio tests (each model nested in the next)
anova(m0, m1, m2)

# Information criteria (lower is better)
AIC(m0, m1, m2)
BIC(m0, m1, m2)

ctable <- coef(summary(m2))
p <- pnorm(abs(ctable[, "t value"]), lower.tail = FALSE) * 2
cbind(round(ctable, 4), "p value" = signif(p, 3))


model_names <- c("Intercept only",
                 "Income",
                 "Income + breakfast")

lr <- anova(m0, m1, m2)

comparison <- data.frame(
  Model          = model_names,
  Parameters     = AIC(m0, m1, m2)$df,
  Resid_Deviance = round(lr$`Resid. Dev`, 2),
  AIC            = round(AIC(m0, m1, m2)$AIC, 2),
  BIC            = round(BIC(m0, m1, m2)$BIC, 2),
  LR_stat        = round(c(NA, lr$`LR stat.`[-1]), 2),
  LR_p           = c(NA, signif(lr$`Pr(Chi)`[-1], 3))
) %>%
  mutate(delta_AIC = round(AIC - min(AIC), 2),
         delta_BIC = round(BIC - min(BIC), 2))

comparison
```
